text: Select: metabolism.met_id, metabolism.met_conversion, metabolism.pathway_key, metabolism.enzyme_name, substrate.compound_name AS substrate_name, parent.compound_name AS parent_name, substrate_struct.canonical_smiles AS substrate_smiles, parent_struct.canonical_smiles AS parent_smiles. Source: metabolism. Join: compound_records substrate_record ON metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate_record.record_id. Join: molecule_dictionary substrate ON substrate_record.molregno = substrate.molregno. Join: compound_structures substrate_struct ON substrate.molregno = substrate_struct.molregno. Join: compound_records parent_record ON metabolism.drug_record_id = parent_record.record_id. Join: molecule_dictionary parent ON parent_record.molregno = parent.molregno. Join: compound_structures parent_struct ON parent.molregno = parent_struct.molregno. Filter: metabolism.tax_id = 9483 (Callithrix jacchus). Sort: metabolism.met_id ascending. Limit: 200.
